# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| Main    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability or exploit within Lithon:

1. **Do not** open a public GitHub issue.
2. Email the core development team directly at `security@project-lithon.org` (or contact `@MotherOfProgrammers`).
3. Include details on how to reproduce the issue.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide updates as fixes are deployed.
